pages.text: White flowers bloomed on the yard tree. The prettiest branch was high up. Momo sat beneath it, looking up.
"I'll pick that branch for the table." Yuki stretched an arm, but their fingertips could not reach it.
Yuki jumped and jumped. Only leaves brushed their fingers. "Just a little higher."
Grandma called from the porch, "Shall I help?" Yuki turned away and jumped again.
Momo caught Yuki's clothes in their mouth and tugged toward the porch. "Let go, Momo." Yuki fetched a long stick.
Yuki tapped the branch with it. Petals showered down.
Only a few flowers remained on the branch. White petals scattered across the yard. "Now it can't go on the table."
Grandma stepped outside. "If you call, you get another helping hand."
"Grandma, please hold the branch." She caught it and pulled it down.
Yuki snapped off the branch. The flowering branch stood in the middle of the table.
